invariants.rationale: The method likely expects a valid drawable name and may pass it to getDrawable, which would fail for null.
Color channel values in libGDX's Color are typically in the [0,1] range.
The green color channel is generally expected to be within [0,1].
The blue color channel is generally expected to be within [0,1].
The alpha channel is typically in [0,1] to represent opacity.
